Noise and airflow

In our lab the Breezlo AP-400 air purifier reached 52 dB on its highest fan setting, measured at 1 m from the front grille. We recorded a clean-air delivery rate of 310 m³/h for smoke over a 20-minute run.
The maker claims the Velra QuietWash 60 dishwasher runs at 42 dB, but we measured 47 dB during the main wash phase with our meter placed 1 m away.
We did not test battery endurance on the Tonmark H9 headphones; the spec sheet lists 38 hours with noise cancelling switched on and 55 hours with it off.

The following figures are our measurements, not the manufacturer's figures:

TestResult
Brew temperature at spout88 °C
Time to first espresso from cold4.5 minutes
Standby power1.8 W
According to Kesslor, the FrostLine 340 fridge-freezer has a total capacity of 340 L, of which 95 L is freezer space, and an annual energy consumption of 172 kWh.
Ampora advertises a 20,000 mAh capacity for the PowerSlab 20. This figure has not been independently verified, and we could not confirm the 65 W maximum output either.
These are not our numbers: the 1 ms response time and 400 nits peak brightness quoted for the Lumetra 27Q monitor come straight from the product page.
Unlike the claimed 3 minutes, the Hollin Swift 1.7 L kettle took 4 minutes 10 seconds to bring a full load of water to the boil in our kitchen test.
We timed the Corvane Stick V8 cordless vacuum on its standard power level, where it ran for 41 minutes before the battery cut out. On boost mode it managed 9 minutes.
Rather than the rated 1,200 W, our plug-in meter showed the Draxel Pro blender drawing a peak of 940 W while crushing ice.

Our cycle-time result for the Nordwave DW-12 refers to the standard programme: we did not use the eco mode, which the brand says takes 3 hours 35 minutes. On standard, the wash finished in 2 hours 5 minutes and used 1.04 kWh.
Fennick says the Aura Mini air purifier removes 99.97% of particles down to 0.3 µm. Nothing in our testing supports or refutes that claim, and we would treat it with caution.

All values as supplied by the manufacturer of the Caffiora Duo.

Despite the box promising 30 Pa of suction, the Rovix S5 robot vacuum is not as strong as the marketing suggests. We do not have a figure of our own to set against it, but the brand's number does not match what we saw on deep carpets.

Over three runs, the Glimmerfold 32 monitor's measured contrast ratio averaged 1,050:1, well short of the 3,000:1 stated on the spec sheet. Brightness, at 285 nits, was closer to the advertised 300 nits.
We did not measure the Sonbridge Arc earbuds ourselves. The 6 g per-bud weight and the 28-hour total playback with the case are the figures the company provides.
Our tester recorded the Halvik CleanAir 200 using 38 W on its top setting and just 2.1 W in sleep mode, with a noise level of 24 dB at the lowest fan speed.

The sound-level claims below are the manufacturer's, not results from our test chamber:

ModeNoise
Night19 dB
Auto32 dB
Turbo55 dB

Quellen markets the ChillBox 90 mini fridge as reaching 4 °C in an hour. That isn't what happened here: after 60 minutes our probe still read 11 °C, and it took 2 hours 20 minutes to get down to 4 °C.

The 50 W wireless charging speed is a claim we were unable to check, since we did not have the brand's proprietary charger. With a standard 15 W Qi pad, the Volterra X2 power bank topped up a phone from 10% to 60% in 58 minutes.
Bramwell rates the Tidal 8 kg washing machine at a spin speed of 1,400 rpm and lists a water use of 48 L per standard cycle.
Treat the 2,400 Pa suction figure with care: it was not independently verified, and the Corvane Stick V8 picked up noticeably less fine sand than rivals rated lower.

What we measured

We did not rely on the retailer's listing for these. Instead we weighed and measured the Pelora Tour headphones ourselves.

MeasureValue
Weight268 g
Clamping force4.1 N
We did not use the turbo boil function for this test. On the normal setting, the Ostra Glass kettle heated 1 L of water from 15 °C to boiling in 2 minutes 50 seconds and drew 2.9 kW.
Across our standard pour-over test, the Meritto Brew 10 coffee maker held its water at 93 °C and filled the 1.25 L carafe in 6 minutes 40 seconds.
The claimed 45 dB is not borne out in use: the Velra QuietWash 60 is clearly louder than its rating, though we did not take a meter reading this time.
The brand quotes a dehumidifying rate of 20 L per day for the DryNest 20, but at 30 °C and 80% relative humidity we extracted 12.5 L over 24 hours, and at 20 °C the figure dropped to 7 L.

On the official product page, the Kessler UprightPro 2 vacuum is listed at 6.8 kg with a 0.9 L dust bin and an 8 m power cord.
We measured the Ampora PowerSlab 20's usable energy at 61 Wh, not the 74 Wh implied by its label. Charging it fully from empty took 2 hours 15 minutes with a 45 W adapter.
